findings.label: Credit apply non-atomicity
findings.description: applyCreditToInvoice in credits/service.js calls repo.decrementCreditGrant and invoicesRepo.addCreditLine in two separate non-transactional calls. A crash between them silently decrements the credit balance with no matching invoice line.
findings.action: Wrap decrementCreditGrant, addCreditLine, and createLedgerEntry in a single prisma.$transaction.

findings.label: Payment-invoice reconciliation race
findings.description: updatePayment in payments/service.js reads invoice.amountPaidMinor, computes the new balance, and writes it back outside a transaction. Concurrent SUCCEEDED transitions for payments on the same invoice overwrite each other's contribution.
findings.action: Move the invoice.findFirst + invoice.update block inside a prisma.$transaction that also wraps repo.updatePayment, or use Prisma's increment operator.

findings.label: processRefund accepts FAILED refunds
findings.description: processRefund in refunds/service.js only guards against existing.status === 'SUCCEEDED'. A FAILED refund passes through and advances to SUCCEEDED, incorrectly updating the parent payment status to REFUNDED or PARTIALLY_REFUNDED.
findings.action: Change the guard to: if (existing.status !== 'PENDING') throw.

findings.label: Webhook signature bypass in production
findings.description: verifyStripeSignature and verifyPayPalSignature return true when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET / PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID are absent. The env schema marks both optional with no production guard, so a production deployment missing these secrets silently accepts any webhook as authentic.
findings.action: Require both secrets when NODE_ENV === 'production', or throw inside the bypass branch when running in production.

findings.label: Raw-body middleware throws on non-JSON payloads
findings.description: app.js line 23 calls JSON.parse(req.rawBody || '{}') without try/catch in the middleware pipeline. A non-JSON webhook body throws a SyntaxError before the router's error handler, producing an unhandled 500.
findings.action: Wrap the JSON.parse call in try/catch and default req.body to {} on failure.
